newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady despite buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates hold steady despite buying.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Wednesday despite moderate buying by textile mills, brokers at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
Mill buying, estimated at more than 12,500 375-lb bales of good quality cotton, including the MNH-93 variety, could not push the prices up, broker Nasim Usman said.

Exporters had not entered the market owing to high prices as fine quality MNH-93 was sold at 2,640 rupees ($65.63) per maund (37.32 kg), including a 10 percent sales tax in the kerb market, Usman said. The NIAB-78 prices ranged from 2,250 to 2,350 rupees per maund.
